facts.query: What is the history of Death Devil?
facts.subject: Death Devil/History
expected: At some point in the past, the Four Horsemen sisters (alongside the Weapon Devils) were locked in a brutal, all-out fight against Pochita (the Chainsaw Devil) in Hell, at the height of which he vanished before their eyes.
